production_component: NetworkPathManager::bind_udp and webrtc-ice candidate recv loop
trigger: A real UDP datagram sent from the candidate socket to a closed loopback port before a valid ICE peer joins.

after.change: SIO_UDP_CONNRESET=false before binding; use the production socket factory for all native WebRTC ICE route modes.
after.raw_socket: No reset delivered; later valid UDP received on the same socket.

limits: Real loopback ICMP and authenticated ICE exercise the production source; the harness does not compile the complete product.
This reproduces a concrete Windows receive-loop defect. There is no historical receive-error evidence proving that this caused the original external Edge failures.
Full GitHub checks and actual external Edge/HL verification remain required.
